name: turbodato-prices
description: See how your prices compare to the competition without leaving ChatGPT. Turbodato monitors your products' prices across online retailers and marketplaces every day and compares them against your own site.

defaultPrompt: Show me the five products with the biggest price gaps versus competitors.
Summarize how competitive our prices are right now.
Find retailers selling below the suggested retail price.
interface.longDescription:
See how your prices compare to the competition without leaving ChatGPT. Turbodato monitors your products' prices across online retailers and marketplaces every day and compares them against your own site. This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to the dashboards you already see in Turbodato.

Ask things like "Which of my products are cheaper at a competitor today?", "Who is selling below our suggested retail price?" or "Summarize the biggest price gaps in the Beverages category." ChatGPT gets an overall price-position summary, the detailed price matrix per retailer and seller, suggested-price (MAP/RRP) compliance, or a bulk export for broader analysis.

Read-only and scoped to your user: ChatGPT sees exactly the dashboards your Turbodato account can see. Requires a Turbodato account.
